title: Standard Gaussian stop-loss identity
statement: For every real $t$, the expected positive part of a standard Gaussian variable minus $t$ equals its density at $t$ minus $t$ times its upper-tail probability at $t$: $\mathbb{E}(Z-t)^+=\varphi(t)-t\,\mathbb{P}(Z>t)$, where $Z$ is standard Gaussian and $\varphi$ is its density.
